The state of the healing art at Simpson's birth--Birthplace--Family   superstitions--His father's bakery--His mother's Huguenot   descent--Commencement of schooldays--Natural and antiquarian   features of Bathgate district--The village hand-loom weavers as   antiquarians and naturalists--His interest in Nature and craving   for knowledge--Brothers' and sister's care for him--Size of his   head--Village doctor's record of his birth--Schooldays cease at age   of fourteen--Influence of his environment in developing his   character.

arxiv-2103-00585.title: Digital Topological Complexity of Digital Maps
arxiv-2103-00585.creator: MELİH İS and İSMET KARACA
arxiv-2103-00585.description: Abstract . In this study, we improve the topological complexity computations on digital images with introducing the digital topological complexity computations of a surjective and digitally continuous map between digital images. We also reveal differences in topological complexity computations of maps between digital images and topological spaces.

arxiv-2110-15345.title: Measuring the Consolidation of DNS and Web Hosting Providers
arxiv-2110-15345.creator: Synthia Wang, Kyle MacMillan, Brennan Schaffner, Marshini Chetty, Nick Feamster
arxiv-2110-15345.description: Abstract Despite the Internet’s continued growth, it increasingly depends on a small set of service providers to support Domain Name System (DNS) and web content hosting. This trend poses many potential threats including susceptibility to outages, failures, and potential censorship by providers.

arxiv-2207-08461.title: Multi-dimension Geospatial feature learning for urban region function recognition
arxiv-2207-08461.creator: Wenjia Xu, Jiuniu Wang, Yirong Wu
arxiv-2207-08461.description: Abstract Urban region function recognition plays a vital character in monitoring and managing the limited urban areas. Since urban functions are complex and full of social-economic properties, simply using remote sensing (RS) images equipped with physical and optical information cannot completely solve the classification task.

arxiv-2310-08640.title: Probe particles in odd active viscoelastic fluids: how activity and dissipation determine linear stability
arxiv-2310-08640.creator: Charlie Duclut a, Stefano Bo a, Ruben Lier a, Jay Armas, Piotr Surówka, Frank Jülicher
arxiv-2310-08640.description: Abstract Odd viscoelastic materials are constrained by fewer symmetries than their even counterparts. The breaking of these symmetries allows these materials to exhibit different features, which have attracted considerable attention in recent years. Immersing a bead in such complex fluids allows for probing their physical properties, highlighting signatures of their oddity and exploring the consequences of these broken symmetries.

arxiv-2403-15968.title: Symplectic Differential Reduction Algebras and Generalized Weyl Algebras
arxiv-2403-15968.creator: Jonas T. HARTWIG a and Dwight Anderson WILLIAMS II b
arxiv-2403-15968.description: Abstract Given a map Ξ : U ⁡ ( 𝔤 ) → A \Xi\colon U(\mathfrak{g})\rightarrow A of associative algebras, with U ⁡ ( 𝔤 ) U(\mathfrak{g}) the universal enveloping algebra of a (complex) finite-dimensional reductive Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} , the restriction functor from A A -modules to U ⁡ ( 𝔤 ) U(\mathfrak{g}) -modules is intimately tied to the

arxiv-2405-08959.title: Tunable moiré materials for probing Berry physics and topology
arxiv-2405-08959.creator: Pratap Chandra Adak, Subhajit Sinha, Amit Agarwal, Mandar M. Deshmukh
arxiv-2405-08959.description: Abstract Berry curvature physics and quantum geometric effects have been instrumental in advancing topological condensed matter physics in recent decades. Although Landau level-based flat bands and conventional 3D solids have been pivotal in exploring rich topological phenomena, they are constrained by their limited ability to undergo dynamic tuning.

arxiv-2407-08104.title: Motion of a weakly charged rotating black hole in a homogeneous electromagnetic field
arxiv-2407-08104.creator: Valeri P. Frolov, Alex Koek
arxiv-2407-08104.description: Abstract In this paper we consider a rotating black hole with electric and magnetic monopole charges that moves in a static homogeneous electromagnetic field. We assume that both the charges and the fields are weak, so that they have no effect on the spacetime geometry, which is described by the Kerr metric.

arxiv-2503-11738.title: Generalized Bayesian Ensemble Survival Tree (GBEST) model
arxiv-2503-11738.creator: Elena Ballante, Pietro Muliere, Silvia Figini
arxiv-2503-11738.description: Abstract This paper proposes a new class of predictive models for survival analysis called Generalized Bayesian Ensemble Survival Tree (GBEST). It is well known that survival analysis poses many different challenges, in particular when applied to small data or censorship mechanism.

arxiv-2507-10988.title: Short geodesics and multiplicities of eigenvalues of hyperbolic surfaces
arxiv-2507-10988.creator: Xiang He, Yunhui Wu, Haohao Zhang
arxiv-2507-10988.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiang He, Yunhui Wu, Haohao Zhang. In this paper, we obtain upper bounds on the multiplicity of Laplacian eigenvalues for closed hyperbolic surfaces in terms of the number of short closed geodesics and the genus g g . For example, we show that if the number of short closed geodesics is sublinear in g g , then the multiplicity of the first eigenvalue is also sublinear in g g .

arxiv-2508-20522.title: VisiTrail: A Cognitive Visualization Tool for Time-Series Analysis of Eye Tracking Data from Attention Game
arxiv-2508-20522.creator: Abdul Rehman a , Ilona Heldal a , and Jerry Chun-Wei Lin a
arxiv-2508-20522.description: Abstract Eye Tracking (ET) can help to understand visual attention and cognitive processes in interactive environments. In attention tasks, distinguishing between relevant target objects and distractors is crucial for effective performance, yet the underlying gaze patterns that drive successful task completion remain incompletely understood.

arxiv-2509-13785.title: Summary on The Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model Challenge: Datasets, Tasks, Baselines, and Methods
arxiv-2509-13785.creator: Bingshen Mu, Pengcheng Guo, Zhaokai Sun, Shuai Wang, Hexin Liu, Mingchen Shao, Lei Xie, Eng Siong Chng, Longshuai Xiao, Qiangze Feng, Daliang Wang
arxiv-2509-13785.description: Abstract This paper summarizes the Interspeech2025 Multilingual Conversational Speech Language Model (MLC-SLM) challenge, which aims to advance the exploration of building effective multilingual conversational speech LLMs (SLLMs). We provide a detailed description of the task settings for the MLC-SLM challenge, the released real-world multilingual conversational speech dataset totaling approximately 1,604 hours, and the baseline systems for participants.

arxiv-2512-14124.title: Complete Characterizations of Well-Posedness in Parametric Composite Optimization
arxiv-2512-14124.creator: Boris S. Mordukhovich, Peipei Tang, Chengjing Wang
arxiv-2512-14124.description: Abstract This paper provides complete characterization of well-posedness for Karush–Kuhn–Tucker (KKT) systems associated with general problems of perturbed composite optimization. Leveraging the property of parabolic regularity for composite models, we show that the second-order subderivative of the cost function reduces to the novel second-order variational function playing a crucial role in the subsequent analysis.

arxiv-2512-23023.title: Total decay rate of a muon bound to a light nucleus
arxiv-2512-23023.creator: A. Czarnecki, A. O. Davydov, M. Y. Kaygorodov
arxiv-2512-23023.description: Abstract We revisit the total decay rate of a muon being in the ground state of a Coulomb potential with atomic charge numbers 4 ≤ Z ≤ 9 4\leq Z\leq 9 . The discrepancy between the perturbative ( α ​ Z ) 2 (\alpha Z)^{2} result of [Phys. Rev.

arxiv-2602-15185.title: Finding the Edge of Chaos in a Ferromagnet: Quantifying the “Complexity” of 2D Ising Phase Transitions with Image Compression
arxiv-2602-15185.creator: Cooper Jacobus
arxiv-2602-15185.description: Abstract The data-driven characterization of the “complexity” present in dynamical systems remains an open problem with broad applications across the physical sciences. We investigate the “structural complexity” of the 2D ferromagnetic Ising model, a paradigmatic system exhibiting a second-order phase transition at a certain critical temperature which is often cited as a canonical example of complex morphology.

pmc-10562193.title: A common low dimensional structure of cognitive impairment in stroke and brain tumors
pmc-10562193.creator: Silvia Facchini, Chiara Favaretto, Marco Castellaro, Andrea Zangrossi, Margherita Zannin, Antonio Luigi Bisogno, Valentina Baro, Maria Giulia Anglani, Antonio Vallesi, Claudio Baracchini, Domenico D'Avella, Alessandro Della Puppa, Carlo Semenza, Maurizio Corbetta
pmc-10562193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Highlights•Focal lesions like stroke and tumors cause highly-impacting cognitive impairment.•Pathophysiological mechanism (acute vs low-growing) affects differently the brain.•Focal lesions show a low-dimensional characterization of cognitive impairment.•Lesion location is correlated with cognitive deficits only in stroke, not in tumor.Keywords: Stroke, Neuro-oncology, Neuropsychology, Cognition, Neural networks Introduction Research in neuropsychology has traditionally focused on the behavioral effects of focal brain injuries, especially stroke and brain tumors.

pmc-10576462.title: The Activation of cGAS-STING in Acute Kidney Injury
pmc-10576462.creator: Chuanchuan Sun, Heng Shi, Xinhai Zhao, Yu-Ling Chang, Xianghong Wang, Shiping Zhu, Shengyun Sun
pmc-10576462.description: The activation of the cGAS-STING pathway is associated with many sterile inflammatory and inflammatory conditions, including acute kidney injury. As a cytoplasmic DNA sensor, sensitization of the cGAS-STING pathway can ignite the innate immune response in vivo and trigger a series of biological effects.

pmc-10604145.title: Influence of Positive Thinking Ideology on Physician Representations of Cancer
pmc-10604145.creator: Luis Felipe Higuita-Gutiérrez, Diego Alejandro Estrada-Mesa, Walter Alfredo Salas-Zapata, Jaiberth Antonio Cardona-Arias
pmc-10604145.description: : ObjectiveTo understand the influence of positive thinking ideology on cancer representations among physicians in the city of Medellín. Methods: This qualitative study was conducted on the basis of the theoretical and methodological elements of Corbin and Strauss’s grounded theory.

pmc-11359938.title: Cost-Effectiveness Analysis of Herpes Zoster Vaccination in a Chinese Population: Recombinant Subunit Vaccine versus Live Attenuated Vaccine
pmc-11359938.creator: Jiaqi Wang, Pengfei Jin, Hui Jin, Qiang Wang, Fengcai Zhu, Jingxin Li, Philipp Lambach, Pedro Plans-Rubió
pmc-11359938.description: Background: Currently, the recombinant subunit vaccine and live attenuated vaccine in the prevention of herpes zoster are approved for marketing in China. This study aims to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of the recombinant subunit vaccine and the live attenuated vaccine in the Chinese population.

pmc-11551781.title: Combination Immunotherapy With Radiotherapy in Non‐Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Review of Evidence
pmc-11551781.creator: Justin L. Burr, Kurtis C. Johnson, Joseph J. Carmicheal, Chi Lin, Apar Kishor Ganti
pmc-11551781.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundRadiotherapy plays a fundamental role in the treatment of patients with all stages of non‐small‐cell lung cancer (NSCLC). The emergence of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) has transformed the standard of care in these patients. The use of ICIs is increasingly utilized in the definitive setting as an adjunct to chemoradiotherapy or surgery and remains a vital component in the treatment of metastatic disease.

pmc-12420226.title: REST corepressor 2 contributes to the cell proliferation of endometrial cancer
pmc-12420226.creator: Qingjuan Zhu, Xin Yang, Yuchun Lv
pmc-12420226.description: BackgroundUterine corpus endometrial cancer (UCEC) is a prevalent gynecological malignancy. REST corepressor 2 (RCOR2), a nuclear transcription co-repressor, has been implicated in various cellular processes. However, its regulatory role in UCEC progression remains unclear.MethodsRCOR2 expression levels were analyzed in UCEC tissues and cell lines using qPCR, Western blotting.

pmc-12651505.title: Effects of Spice Mixtures and Konjac Glucomannan–Whey Protein Isolate Based Edible Films on the Microbiological Stability and Textural Properties of Cheese
pmc-12651505.creator: Aslı Çelikel Güngör, Mutlu Buket Akın, Emir Ayşe Özer
pmc-12651505.description: Some of the main factors affecting the product quality and shelf life of cheese include weight loss during storage, microbial spoilage, and structural changes in processing technology. Edible films are coating materials produced with the aim of improving quality properties and extending shelf life, and various studies have been conducted on their properties.

pmc-12661436.title: Ventral pallidum efferent pathways via mediodorsal thalamus and lateral habenula mediate default mode network regulation
pmc-12661436.creator: Epistimi-Anna Makedona, Mu-En Kuo, Michael Harvey, Gregor Rainer
pmc-12661436.description: SummaryTransitions between internal and external focus are fundamental to cognition. These shifts depend on the modulation of the default mode network (DMN), of which the ventral pallidum (VP) is a key subcortical node. Here, we examine which VP efferent pathways mediate these transitions, using projection and cell type specific optogenetic silencing.

pmc-12949493.title: Longitudinal urinary LAM measurements in pulmonary tuberculosis patients: preliminary observations
pmc-12949493.creator: Vasiliki Kolokotroni, Irini Gerogianni, Konstantinos I. Gourgoulianis, Garyfallia Perlepe
pmc-12949493.description: BackgroundMonitoring treatment response in pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is critical, but non-invasive biomarkers are limited for patients unable to produce sputum.ObjectiveTo evaluate the utility of the PATHFAST TB LAM Ag assay in urine for diagnosis and treatment monitoring of pulmonary TB.MethodsNine patients with confirmed TB at the University Hospital of Larissa, Greece, were followed longitudinally.

pmc-13214550.title: Trial-by-trial covariation of pupil dilation, microsaccades, and visual evoked potentials during saliency processing
pmc-13214550.creator: Yi-Hsuan Chang, Chen-Chung Kuo, Cesar Barquero, Chin-An Wang
pmc-13214550.description: SummarySalient stimuli evoke multiple orienting responses, including microsaccades, pupil dilation, and visually evoked potentials (VEPs); yet, these signals are typically studied in isolation, leaving unclear whether they covary systematically during visual orienting. We simultaneously recorded eye movements, pupil size, and EEG while participants performed a visual discrimination task with varying stimulus contrast.

pmc-13388138.title: A preliminary study on brain functional magnetic resonance imaging in migraine patients with visual aura using visual stimulation
pmc-13388138.creator: Jinyao Li, Mu Lan, Xin Yang, Xiaoming Wang, Quansheng Liu, Xinyi Wang
pmc-13388138.description: Background and ObjectiveMigraine is characterized by high prevalence, recurrent attacks, and poor response to pharmacological interventions, which can severely impair patients’ quality of life. The complex and diverse aura symptoms in its clinical presentation further increase the risk of misdiagnosis and mismanagement. Moreover, the pathogenesis of this disorder remains incompletely understood.

pmc-13544976.title: Rapidly Enlarging Forearm Mass in a 74-Year-Old Male: A Case of Merkel Cell Carcinoma Presenting as a Soft Tissue Tumor
pmc-13544976.creator: Sierra A Ziegler, Corey R Zimmer, Brian Ziegler
pmc-13544976.description: Merkel cell carcinoma (MCC) is a rare, aggressive cutaneous neuroendocrine malignancy that most commonly presents in elderly patients as a rapidly growing lesion on sun-exposed skin. Because of its nonspecific clinical appearance, it can mimic a variety of benign and malignant soft tissue conditions, making diagnosis challenging.
